lines.en: On Mars when he is in his own house, and

lines.text: aliorum Planetarum.
lines.en: of the other Planets.

lines.text: CVm Mars fuerit in domo Saturni, natus
lines.en: When Mars is in the house of Saturn, the native

lines.text: erit audax, diabolus, perficiẽs ipſe omnes
lines.en: will be bold, devilish, he himself accomplishing all

lines.text: res quas incipit, ſed diſsipabit opes paren
lines.en: things which he begins, but he will dissipate the wealth of his parents,

lines.text: tum ſuorum, ac uidebit mortem fratrum
lines.en: and he will see the death of his older brothers.

lines.text: ſuorũ maiorũ. Eodem in domo Iouis cõ
lines.en: The same [Mars] delaying in the house of Jupiter,

lines.text: morante, natus erit nobilis, honoratus, & pulcher, ami
lines.en: the native will be noble, honored, and beautiful, a friend

lines.text: cus nobilium ac magnatũ. Et ſi fuerit Iupiter in domo
lines.en: of nobles and magnates. And if Jupiter is in the house

lines.text: Martis uiciſsim in configuratione bona, erit natus ue
lines.en: of Mars in turn in a good configuration, the native will be

lines.text: lut ductor exercituum, & uincens aduerſarios ſuos. Si
lines.en: like a leader of armies, and conquering his adversaries. If

lines.text: uerò in domo ſua permanſerit, erit nominatus hono
lines.en: however he remains in his own house, he will be named honored,

lines.text: ratus, & diues, & fortè erit ingenioſus, ac doctus, peri
lines.en: and rich, and perhaps he will be ingenious, and learned, skilled

lines.text: tus Geometriæ, habebitq́; bonos ſucceſſus in omni
lines.en: in Geometry, and he will have good successes in all

lines.text: bus ſuis operibus, maximè ſi fuerit natiuitas nocturna.
lines.en: his works, especially if it is a nocturnal nativity.

lines.text: Quòd ſi in diurna euenerit, & fuerit in Ariete, non aſ
lines.en: But if it happens in a diurnal one, and he is in Aries, not

lines.text: picientibus eum fortunis, erit malignus, inferens om
lines.en: looking at him with fortunes, he will be malignant, bringing

lines.text: nibus iniurias, & accident ei dolores occulti, & caſus
lines.en: injuries to all, and hidden pains will happen to him, and a fall

lines.text: ab alto. Et ſi in Scorpione extiterit, aliquid ex prædi
lines.en: from a height. And if he is in Scorpio, something of the aforesaid

lines.text: ctis minuetur. Si in domo Solis extiterit, ſignificat
lines.en: will be diminished. If he is in the house of the Sun, it signifies

lines.text: mortem nati ex infirmitate, quam habebit in uentre,
lines.en: the death of the native from an infirmity, which he will have in the belly,

lines.text: & propriè in ſtomacho, in oculis, & operabitur quæ
lines.en: and properly in the stomach, in the eyes, and he will work things which

lines.text: grauia ſunt ad operandum per ignem, & erit mors
lines.en: are heavy to work by fire, and his death will be

summary.headline: Mars in Planetary Houses
summary.text: Chapter 41 discusses Mars in the houses of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, and the Sun, describing effects on character, status, wealth, learning, military success, injuries, illness, and death, with distinctions between nocturnal and diurnal nativities and between Aries and Scorpio.
